goal: Renew the exact outcome-blind intake monitor after its second normal 145-poll completion without changing the intake contract, archive order, or scientific estimand.
allowed_change: Invoke the same installed exact monitor once in --initialize mode, append a third poll cycle to the existing log, and write a separate immutable safe receipt.
forbidden_changes: changing archive order or selecting an archive
changing intake, scorer, registry, stability, alias, or security configuration
reading archive payload identities beyond the existing credential-first structural intake
reading labels, outcomes, predictions, accuracy, utility, candidate profile, or private selection
starting GPU work, paid API calls, model fitting, or a base-model update
overwriting previous logs, receipts, failed attempts, or completion evidence
